ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: The archery idiom names complete accuracy, but Chan speakers also turn it against success: Xuzhou praises Baoshou as a hundred-for-a-hundred hitter before exposing all three participants, while Songyuan says such hits collide with walls.
EvidenceBody: Some cases praise reliable hitting, while others explicitly say the same perfect record remains inadequate or costly; the arrow-score image itself stays unchanged.
